# Technical Plan: Nemotron-H Hybrid Inference on 12GB CUDA GPU

## Executive Summary
This plan addresses the critical memory constraint of running Nemotron-H hybrid MoE models on a 12GB GPU. The architecture contains Mamba2 SSM layers, attention layers, shared-expert FFN branches, and MoE expert branches that collectively exceed VRAM capacity. The strategy employs **selective GPU offloading** with CPU RAM overflow for expert tensors, while keeping latency-sensitive components (Mamba, attention, router) on GPU.

---

## 1. Tensor Offloading Strategy

### 1.1 GPU-Resident Tensors (Latency-Sensitive)
The following tensors must remain on GPU for acceptable latency:

| Tensor Name | Code Path | Size Justification |
|---|---|---|
| `tok_embd` | `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp:18` | Embedding lookup - critical for token processing |
| `output_norm` / `output` | `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp:22-27` | Final normalization and lm_head projection |
| `layer.attn_norm` | `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp:70` | Attention RMSNorm - required before every QKV computation |
| `layer.ssm_in` | `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp:77` | Mamba2 input projection - recurrent layer prerequisite |
| `layer.ssm_conv1d` / `layer.ssm_conv1d_b` | `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp:78` | Mamba2 convolutional projection |
| `layer.ssm_dt_b` | `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp:79` | Mamba2 time-step projection |
| `layer.ssm_a` / `layer.ssm_d` | `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp:80-81` | Mamba2 A and D matrices for SSM recurrence |
| `layer.ssm_norm` | `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp:82` | Mamba2 layer norm over `d_inner/n_group` |
| `layer.ssm_out` | `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp:83` | Mamba2 output projection to `n_embd` |
| `layer.wo` / `layer.wo_b` | `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp:91-92` | Attention output projection |
|
